item.title: Enduring Leadership and Career Longevity
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260204135127_020526ron-culp.webp" alt="Ron Culp" />In this episode of Taking the Lead, Culp reflects on what effective leadership looks like when career paths are less predictable, expectations are shifting, and leaders are being asked to develop people at every stage of their journey.</p>
